answer: Work-slot burning stops bulk fakes. An agent burns 20 units for one work slot per epoch; the deposit is gone if work fails, so idle shells cost money. A probe exposing one fake sends a ripple through neighbors, re-checking linked identities, and confirmed fakes are marked umber. Hollow shells collapse like sinkholes in karst terrain. Forging 1,000 slots costs 20,000 per epoch; an honest agent burns 20 per epoch, keeping rewards undiluted.
